title: Travel Time Prediction in Supply Chain Management Using Machine Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.38190v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The purpose of this research is to find data and methods using machine learning and deep learning to correctly predict the estimated travel time for transportation and logistics in a supply chain system. The supply chain ecosystem is very complex and heavily relies on the transportation and logistics of raw materials and finished goods. Accurate travel time estimation is critical because it helps supply chain members to improve logistics consistency and performance. This helps in planning, demand forecasting, lead time management and assembly planning. The logistics on the delivery side of the customer also plays a crucial role in customer satisfaction and voice of customer. With the collection of huge historical data and using novel techniques, the research builds an accurate model to predict travel time of inventory.

translated_title: 使用机器学习进行供应链管理中的行程时间预测
translated_abstract: 本研究的目的是利用机器学习和深度学习找到数据和方法，以正确预测供应链系统中运输和物流的预计行程时间。供应链生态系统非常复杂，严重依赖原材料和成品的运输与物流。准确的行程时间估计至关重要，因为它能帮助供应链成员提高物流的一致性和绩效，这有助于规划、需求预测、提前期管理和装配计划。客户交付端的物流在客户满意度和客户之声方面也起着至关重要的作用。通过收集大量历史数据并采用新颖的技术，该研究构建了一个准确的模型来预测库存的运输时间。
tldr: 该研究利用机器学习和深度学习技术，基于大量历史数据构建了准确的模型来预测供应链运输和物流的行程时间，从而提升物流一致性与客户满意度。
en_tdlr: This research builds an accurate machine learning and deep learning model using massive historical data to predict travel time in supply chain transportation and logistics, improving logistics consistency and customer satisfaction.
